description: Redesign all remaining page templates and their CSS: auth pages (login, register), landing page (index.html), documents page, dashboard, history, profile, admin dashboard, and error pages. Each page gets dark glass Nebula styling. Also create static/css/auth.css (rewrite), static/css/landing.css (rewrite), static/css/dashboard.css (rewrite), and handle admin/error styles in main.css or static/css/admin.css. Independent of FEAT-002 except for shared CSS variables from FEAT-001.
steps: Rewrite static/css/auth.css completely. New styles: body.auth-page: background var(--bg-base); display flex; align-items center; justify-content center; min-height 100vh; padding 2rem 1rem. Center a radial violet glow: body.auth-page::before: content ''; position fixed; top 50%; left 50%; transform translate(-50%,-50%); width 600px; height 600px; background radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(124,58,237,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events none; z-index 0. body.auth-page .main-content: padding 0 !important; margin 0 !important; width 100%; display flex; align-items center; justify-content center. .auth-container: width 100%; max-width 420px; position relative; z-index 1. .auth-card: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-lg); padding 2.5rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur); box-shadow var(--glass-shadow). .auth-logo: display flex; align-items center; justify-content center; margin-bottom 1.75rem — a div.logo-circle width 48px; height 48px; background var(--violet); border-radius 12px; display flex; align-items center; justify-content center; font-size 1.3rem; font-weight 800; color #fff. .auth-title: text-align center; font-size 1.4rem; font-weight 700; color var(--text-primary); margin-bottom 0.3rem. .auth-subtitle: text-align center; color var(--text-secondary); font-size 0.9rem; margin-bottom 1.75rem. .auth-card .form-input: background var(--bg-input); border: var(--glass-border); color var(--text-primary) — inherits from main.css. .auth-card .btn-primary: padding 0.75rem; font-size 0.95rem; border-radius var(--radius-md); box-shadow 0 0 20px var(--violet-glow); margin-top 0.5rem; width 100%; justify-content center. .auth-footer: text-align center; margin-top 1.5rem; font-size 0.875rem; color var(--text-secondary). .auth-footer a: color var(--violet-light); font-weight 500; text-decoration none. .password-strength: height 4px; background var(--border); border-radius 2px; margin-top 0.5rem; overflow hidden. .strength-bar: height 100%; width 0; border-radius 2px; transition width 0.3s, background 0.3s. .strength-bar.weak: background var(--error); width 33%. .strength-bar.medium: background var(--warning); width 66%. .strength-bar.strong: background var(--success); width 100%.

Update templates/auth/login.html. Replace .auth-logo content:
C
(remove old Crystal). No other structural changes needed — the form IDs and JS hooks are preserved. Add {% block extra_css %} if missing.
Update templates/auth/register.html. Same logo change as login.html. No other structural changes.

Rewrite static/css/landing.css completely. The landing page (index.html) already has rich structure (hero, features, how-it-works, CTA, footer). New styles: body.landing .main-content: padding 0; margin-left 0. .landing-page: min-height 100vh; background var(--bg-base); position relative; overflow-x hidden. Add a global radial glow: .landing-page::before: content ''; position fixed; top 0; left 0; right 0; height 100vh; background radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, rgba(124,58,237,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%); pointer-events none; z-index 0. .landing-header: position fixed; top 0; left 0; right 0; z-index 100; display flex; align-items center; justify-content space-between; padding 0 2.5rem; height 64px; background rgba(19,19,31,0.8); border-bottom: var(--glass-border); backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur). .landing-logo: display flex; align-items center; gap 0.625rem; font-size 1.1rem; font-weight 700; color var(--text-primary); text-decoration none — includes a .logo-orb (violet circle with C). .landing-nav-actions .btn-outline: border-color rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color var(--text-secondary); hover: background var(--bg-card). .landing-nav-actions .btn-primary: standard violet button. Hero: .hero: display grid; grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr; gap 4rem; align-items center; min-height 100vh; max-width 1200px; margin 0 auto; padding 7rem 2.5rem 4rem; position relative; z-index 1. .hero-badge: display inline-flex; padding 0.35rem 0.9rem; background var(--violet-pale); border: 1px solid var(--border-active); border-radius 99px; font-size 0.8rem; color var(--violet-light). .hero-title: font-size clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight 800; color var(--text-primary); line-height 1.15. .accent: background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet-light), var(--violet)); -webkit-background-clip text; -webkit-text-fill-color transparent. .hero-subtitle: color var(--text-secondary); font-size 1.05rem; max-width 480px. .hero-actions: display flex; gap 1rem. .hero-stats: display flex; gap 2rem; margin-top 0.5rem. .stat-item .stat-value: font-size 1.5rem; font-weight 700; color var(--violet-light). .stat-item .stat-label: font-size 0.8rem; color var(--text-muted). Chat preview card: .chat-preview-card: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-lg); padding 1.25rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur); box-shadow var(--glass-shadow). .preview-bubble--user: background var(--bg-message-user); color #fff; border-radius var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 4px var(--radius-md). .preview-bubble--assistant: background var(--bg-message-ai); border: var(--glass-border); color var(--text-primary); border-radius var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 4px. .preview-source: font-size 0.72rem; color var(--violet-light); margin-top 0.5rem; padding-top 0.4rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border). Features: .features: padding 5rem 2.5rem; background rgba(255,255,255,0.01). .feature-card: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-md); padding 1.75rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur); transition background 0.15s, transform 0.15s. .feature-card:hover: background var(--bg-card-hover); transform translateY(-4px). .feature-icon-wrap: width 44px; height 44px; background var(--violet-pale); border-radius var(--radius-sm); display flex; align-items center; justify-content center; color var(--violet-light); font-weight 700; margin-bottom 1rem. CTA section: .cta-section: padding 5rem 2.5rem; text-align center. .cta-inner: max-width 600px; margin 0 auto; background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-xl); padding 3rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur). Landing footer: .landing-footer: padding 2rem 2.5rem; border-top: var(--glass-border); display flex; justify-content space-between; align-items center; color var(--text-muted); font-size 0.875rem. Responsive: at 768px, hero becomes single column.

Update templates/index.html. Replace .feature-icon-wrap letter placeholders (D, A, P, F) with actual inline SVG icons (16x16, stroke-based): D→ file-text SVG, A→ citation/checkmark SVG, P→ lock SVG, F→ lightning-bolt SVG. Add a .logo-orb div inside .landing-logo (violet circle with letter C). These are the only structural changes — preserve all Jinja2 expressions and text content.

Rewrite static/css/dashboard.css completely. New styles: .dashboard-grid: display grid; grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px,1fr)); gap 1.5rem. .dashboard-card: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-md); padding 1.5rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur); transition background 0.15s. .dashboard-card:hover: background var(--bg-card-hover). .dashboard-card h2: color var(--text-primary); font-size 1rem; margin-bottom 0.75rem. .dashboard-card p: color var(--text-secondary). .dashboard-card--highlight: border-left: 2px solid var(--violet); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-card), rgba(124,58,237,0.05)). .suggestion-list .suggestion-chip: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); color var(--text-secondary); hover: border-color var(--border-active); color var(--text-primary). .session-row: border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border). .session-row-title: color var(--text-secondary). .session-row-title:hover: color var(--violet-light).

Redesign templates/student/documents.html. Key changes: (1) Replace emoji upload icon 📁 with an inline SVG upload icon (cloud-upload: circle-with-arrow-up). (2) Style .upload-zone as a dark glass dashed upload zone: background var(--bg-card); border: 2px dashed var(--border); border-radius var(--radius-lg); padding 3rem 2rem; text-align center; transition border-color 0.15s. .upload-zone.dragover: border-color var(--violet); background var(--violet-pale). Add these styles to dashboard.css (since documents.html uses dashboard.css) or create a separate upload block in main.css. Add: .upload-zone { background: var(--bg-card); border: 2px dashed var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 3rem 2rem; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .upload-zone.dragover { border-color: var(--violet); background: var(--violet-pale); } .upload-icon { color: var(--text-muted); width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0 auto 1rem; display: block; } .upload-text { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.95rem; } .upload-link { color: var(--violet-light); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; } .upload-hint { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; } .progress-bar { height: 100%; background: var(--violet); border-radius: 99px; transition: width 0.3s; } .upload-progress { background: var(--border); border-radius: 99px; height: 6px; margin-top: 1rem; overflow: hidden; } .docs-table-wrap { background: var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 1.5rem; }

Rewrite static/css/admin.css. New dark glass styles: .admin-stats: display grid; grid-template-columns repeat(4, 1fr); gap 1rem; margin-bottom 2rem. .stat-card: background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-md); padding 1.5rem; backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur). .stat-value: font-size 2rem; font-weight 700; color var(--text-primary). .stat-label: color var(--text-muted); font-size 0.8rem; margin-top 0.25rem. .stat-card--alert: border-color rgba(239,68,68,0.3); background rgba(239,68,68,0.05). .admin-tabs: display flex; gap 0.25rem; margin-bottom 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom 0. .tab-btn: padding 0.6rem 1.25rem; background none; border none; color var(--text-muted); cursor pointer; font-size 0.875rem; font-weight 500; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s. .tab-btn--active: color var(--violet-light); border-bottom-color var(--violet). .admin-actions: margin-bottom 1rem.

Update all error templates to replace emoji error-visual divs with styled SVG icons. templates/errors/403.html: replace 🚫 emoji div with inline SVG shield-x icon. templates/errors/404.html: replace 🔍 with inline SVG magnifier icon. templates/errors/413.html: check content and replace emoji. templates/errors/500.html: replace ⚡ with inline SVG warning icon. templates/errors/400.html: check and replace emoji. Add .error-visual class styles to main.css: .error-visual { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 0 auto 1.5rem; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } where .error-visual svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }.

Update templates/student/history.html: add {% block extra_css %}<link rel='stylesheet' href='{{ url_for('static', filename='css/dashboard.css') }}'>{% endblock %} if not already present (currently it has no extra_css block — the data-table styles come from main.css which is always loaded). Add a glass card wrapper around the table: wrap .history-table-wrap with a div that has background var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius var(--radius-md); overflow hidden. Add inline style or a class to the existing .history-controls search input to ensure it uses the dark glass form-input style.

Update templates/student/profile.html: Add .profile-card styles to main.css or dashboard.css: .profile-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 1.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); } .profile-sections { max-width: 640px; } .profile-card--danger { border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.25); } .modal-content { background: #1A1A2E; } (already in main.css rewrite from FEAT-001 but add profile-specific rules here).

http://localhost:8080/register renders consistently with login page
http://localhost:8080 (landing) renders with dark background, glass header, violet gradient hero title, glass feature cards, glass chat preview
http://localhost:8080/documents renders with glass dashed upload zone, glass document table
http://localhost:8080/dashboard renders with glass dashboard cards
http://localhost:8080/history renders with glass table wrapper
http://localhost:8080/profile renders with glass profile cards and danger zone
Error pages (404, 500) render with dark background, SVG icons (no emoji), violet error code
verification: python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests pass
Visit each page URL and visually confirm dark glass theme
